description: Search active gifts across the account — e.g. everything received in a date range, or gifts to one fund or campaign. Give date/updated bounds and/or raw `terms`. Available term fields: date_from / date_to (YYYY-MM-DD), gift_types (in|ni + comma ids, e.g. in|1,7), gift_amount (gte|lte|btw|gt|lt|eq|ne + number[s], e.g. btw|100|1000), payment_types, campaigns, funds, appeals, events, categories (in|ni|bl + comma ids), appeal_types, event_types, constituent_type (0/1), gift_ids, external_gift_ids, created_from / created_to and updated_from / updated_to (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). At least one term is required. LGL: GET /api/v1/gifts/search.

expand.description: Donor fields to include inline on each gift.

limit.description: Number of entries to return, 1-100. LGL's default is 25.

offset.description: Start at this entry (0-based). Use the previous page's next_item. Default 0.

sort.description: Sort by name, gift_amount, date, date_created, date_updated, fund, appeal, campaign or gift_type. Append '!' to reverse (e.g. date!).

terms.description: Extra raw LGL search terms, each 'field=value' (combined with AND). See the tool description for the available fields.

name: lgl_search_gifts
title: Search gifts
